A '''sept''' is a subdivision of the [[Aiel]] [[clan]]s. Aiel can be of the same clan, but different septs. Each clan has different septs. For example, Jindo is a sept of the Taardad and no other clan would have a Jindo sept. While these are the known septs, it is possible that there are many that are known only within each clan.

While it is not known how many septs a clan normally has, the Shaido has had as many as eighty-three septs '''{{wh|4}}.'''

==Origin==
The word ''sept'' comes from real-world Irish and Scottish [[wikipedia:sept|origins]] where it is used in the context of the division of a family or clan.
